label: READ-ONLY checks for #148 (forwarder deployment readiness). No transaction was sent, nothing was signed, funded or deployed.

evm.provider: https://robinhood-testnet.drpc.org (dRPC) only. The official RPC https://rpc.testnet.chain.robinhood.com refused connections (TCP connection refused) at read time, so this is a single-provider read that may front the same upstream as the official one.

oldDepositContract.meaning: The code is unchanged and still the deposit-only build; the one recorded test deposit (100 mCASHCAT) is still inside it and cannot be moved.

payoutHolder.meaning: An account without code, ready to be the forwarder's holder, with gas for later payouts and no tokens.

evm.estimatedDeployCostWei: 3961600000000 (396160 gas at 0.01 gwei, as recorded for the old deployment; the forwarder adds one immutable)

registryGetClaimForRecordedDeposit.meaning: The recorded deposit was never attested to the registry, so no representation was minted from the tokens locked in the old contract.

payout.registeredSenderPerBacking: not readable: the payout contract exposes no view of `BackingConfigInput`; the registered sender can only be confirmed from the register_backing transaction or by a real payout

limits: Single EVM provider for these reads; re-read through the official RPC when it is reachable before deploying.
The payout contract's registered sender per backing is not confirmed by any view; the holder address comes from the recorded derivation, not from a payout configuration read.
These are reads at one moment, not proof of a working payout path.
